Remark
[Uniqueness of the Euclidean connection]

Source: petersen:page-0088 ↗ def:pet-ch2-covariant-derivative-euclidean ↗ def:pet-ch2-affine-connection

1. ch2:2.5.1The Cartesian connection is the unique affine connection on Euclidean space for which every constant vector field is parallel. \sketch For $X=X^i\partial _i$, the Leibniz rule and $ abla \partial _i=0$ force $ abla _YX=dX^i(Y)\partial _i$, which is subsection 2.1.
